lastCompletedStory.title: Wire one-step-per-tick into the sidecar outer loop and remove eager-delete (closes CAM-103)

nextStoryContext: US-003 rewrote makeProductionMergeWatchFn in sidecar.ts to use stepMergeWatch (one step per idle tick) instead of the blocking runMergeWatch loop. The eager pre-start unlinkSync is gone. On continue: writeMergeWatchState persists state across restarts. On terminal: removeMergeWatchState removes the file. The outer loop is non-blocking because the closure returns promptly. All three CAM-138 US stories are now passes:true. If there is a next story, it should check the PRD for further work; if all stories pass, emit PRD_COMPLETE.

officialDocsValidated.summary: US-003 touches only internal functions (stepMergeWatch, readMergeWatchState, writeMergeWatchState, removeMergeWatchState) exported from src/release/merge-watch.ts. No external npm library was introduced or modified.
